page_note: Pure substrate teaching throughout — systematic exposition of the enthumeseis (faculties) of eyes, ears, smell, and their storehouses/treasuries. The teaching maps each sense organ → houses/chambers → treasuries/apothekai → the process of carrying impressions inward, watching over them, and bringing them forth to a 'petitioner'. This is classic correspondential psychology: faculty → architecture → process, all within the cosmic-psychic system. No frame formulas, no institutional vocabulary, no exhortation, no editorial seams. Heavy physical damage (58.1% ratio, many lacunae) but no register shifts. Final line lost.
